GOAL: Fix the admissible design region for one ideation slot (agent ideation_1, round 4) before writing the proposal.
READ: The round brief, the three failed rounds (0.05439 curved residual chain; 0.05165 geodesic shift toward popularity-adjusted successor barycentre, 99.1% items moved; 0.04823 PPMI-driven fourth SID level), the frozen baseline number ~0.0679, and the four earlier proposals already rejected (poincare-frechet-successor-codebook, CURVCTRL-SID, BRad-RQ, behcone-prefix-rq, LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ, succboost-geoshift, BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ, TSG-SID).
OBSERVED: (a) recall decreases monotonically with how far the SID construction departs from the plain text geometry, not with prefix depth; (b) round three refuted the capacity hypothesis (7x deeper prefixes, worst score); (c) behaviour-contrast metrics are the only positively predictive SID statistic (+0.71), radial term = group compactness, Gromov-delta and ancestor-depth weighting hurt; (d) baseline prefix counts 251/1769/2201 show level 3 is nearly degenerate (1.24 L3 codes per L2 parent), so same-parent L3 sibling swaps are structurally impossible and level-2 (L2) cells inside one L1 group are the only usable exchange granularity.
REASONING: Only shape (A) is evidence-supported. Since all three losses came from MOVING the objects of the quantizer, the mechanism must move nothing that the quantizer owns (codebooks, embeddings, cell set, cell sizes, token vocabulary) and only permute cell MEMBERSHIP for items that sit inside the quantizer's own reconstruction-noise floor; behaviour may then pay a curved toll to buy a relabel. Curvature, being a gauge, can only be load-bearing through the radius/compactness term, so the curved operation must be the PRICE of a move, not a displacement.
EVIDENCE: This record. OPEN: exact formulation of the toll, the derived constants, and the three switches.

GOAL: Settle the derived constants and the switch semantics so that no constant needs tuning and behaviour-off reproduces the baseline bit-exactly.
READ: Own derivation; constraints (a)-(d) of the round brief; frozen-scale numbers 24556 training items, 24 steps/epoch, 3000 epochs, beam 20.
OBSERVED: Three constants are needed and all three are measurable on the Stage-2 training split alone: alpha = 1/max_i||x_i|| (fixes the Poincare map's scale, no free choice); eps_rec = RMS hyperbolic reconstruction error of the frozen 3-level RQ-VAE (the quantizer's own noise floor, so any relabel whose hyperbolic toll is <= eps_rec is invisible to the text geometry at the quantizer's resolution); lambda = eps_rec / sigma_A with sigma_A the measured standard deviation of the PPMI behaviour advantage (so one behaviour standard deviation is priced exactly at one noise floor, and the two terms are commensurate without a weight sweep).
REASONING: With cost Delta(i,s) = toll_P(i,s) - lambda*(A(i,s)-A(i,t(i))) and Delta(i,t(i))=0, behaviour-off (lambda=0) makes every Delta >= 0, so the capacity-frozen optimal transport returns the identity and the SIDs are bit-identical to the baseline. That is the cleanest possible behaviour-off arm and proves the coupling is real. Geometry-off keeps lambda and eps_rec but recomputes both with the Euclidean chord, which yields a different admissible move set. Both-on is the trained arm.
EVIDENCE: This record. OPEN: none; formulate the final block.

FINAL ANSWER (condensed to fit the record limit; full block printed in the reply).
IDEA: TOLLCAP-SID. SHAPE (A): partition provably untouched, only cell membership of noise-floor items changes.
MECHANISM: after the frozen Stage-2 RQ-VAE, run one capacity-frozen optimal transport per level-1 group over the EXISTING SID cells (cell set, cell sizes, codebooks, token vocabulary all frozen and asserted identical). Move cost: Delta(i,s)=[d_P(phi(x_i),m_s)-d_P(phi(x_i),m_t(i))] - (eps_rec/sigma_A)*[A(i,s)-A(i,t(i))], admissible only when the Poincare toll <= eps_rec.
DERIVED CONSTANTS: alpha=1/max||x_i|| (Poincare map, curvature -1 fixed); eps_rec = RMS hyperbolic reconstruction error of the frozen 3-level quantizer (its own noise floor); lambda=eps_rec/sigma_A with sigma_A the measured std of the training-only successor PPMI advantage A(i,s)=log((p(s|i)+eps_p)/(pi(s)+eps_p)); eps_p=1/total transitions.
SWITCHES: behaviour-off sets lambda=0, every Delta>=0 with a 1e-9 identity tie-break, solver returns the identity, SIDs bit-identical to baseline. Geometry-off replaces d_P by the Euclidean chord and recomputes eps_rec/sigma_A under the chord. Both-on is the single trained arm.
WHY NOT THE THREE FAILURE MODES: no prefix merging (cell sizes and all three prefix counts are exactly preserved by the cycle-preserving transport); no moving the input off the text geometry (embeddings and codebooks untouched, per-item toll capped at the quantizer's own RMS error); no fourth argmin level (no new level, no new token, identical SID vocabulary). Curvature is load-bearing only through the radius factor 1/(1-||m_s||^2), i.e. group compactness, the one non-gauge hyperbolic term the round's own measurements identified.
GUARD: rho, per-move tolls, max toll vs eps_rec, before/after behaviour contrast, and exact equality of prefix counts are measured and reported; 5% cycle cap; rollback to baseline if any assertion fails.
COST: zero added per-step work (24556 items, 24 steps/epoch, 3000 epochs) and zero added Stage-3 work; one pass of ~1e5 distances plus 251 linear_sum_assignment calls of ~98x98, under a minute once (~0.3-0.8 ms amortized per step, <1% of Stage-2 wall clock).
HYPOTHESIS: boundary items moved into behaviourally coherent existing cells raise prefix behaviour predictability and Stage-3 test_recall@10 above 0.0679 while prefix counts stay identical; falsified if rho=0 (null, SIDs identical) or if contrast rises without recall.
RISKS: empty admissible shell (null result); popularity-driven hub concentration; training-graph contrast not transferring to beam search.
LEAKAGE: transitions, pi, sigma_A, eps_rec, alpha all from the Stage-2 training split only, frozen before Stage 3; no validation/test interaction enters the SID construction; the frozen Stage-3 protocol sees only t'.
Observables: rho, toll distribution, contrast delta, identical L1/L2/L3 counts, Stage-3 prefix accuracy (diagnostic), test_recall@10.
